layouts.name: Three Sisters
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Three Sisters Full Circuit, Three Sisters Perimeter Circuit, Three Sisters Club Circuit. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Three Sisters Full Circuit
layouts.description: The operator Full Circuit diagram identifies the full outer Conrod and Coward's Summit, western Lunar Bend, Rogerson's Straight and Lucy's Valley loop, with the smooth Esses crossover. The inner Penrith climb, Joey Dunlop return and angular pit detour are excluded. Independent mapped distance is 1450.5 m; the operator states 1473 m.

layouts.name: Three Sisters Perimeter Circuit
layouts.description: The operator Perimeter Circuit diagram identifies full outer Conrod and Coward's Summit, western Lunar Bend and the Rogerson's Straight return, bypassing Lucy's Valley and the Joey Dunlop hairpin. The pinned source loop measures 1122.4 m; pit roads are excluded.

layouts.name: Three Sisters Club Circuit
layouts.description: The operator Club Circuit diagram identifies Lunar Bend, Rogerson's Straight, the inner Penrith climb and complete Joey Dunlop hairpin, bypassing the outer Coward's Summit and Lucy's Valley. The pinned source loop measures 1045.3 m; pit and angular service connectors are excluded.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The general venue configuration includes the operator named Full, Perimeter and Club circuits. The published route diagrams identify the outer Coward Summit return, inner Penrith climb, Lucy Valley and complete Joey Dunlop hairpin. Each route is separately selectable. Their union excludes the angular pit detour and is displayed as a configuration network rather than a lap. The independent unique branch distance is 1712.2 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
